collections.name: Bestsellers
collections.description: A handful of favorites to start with.

products.title: Rowan Field Notebook
products.description: A pocket-size dot-grid notebook for lists, sketches, and half-formed ideas. Lay-flat binding, 120 pages of thick cream paper that won’t bleed, and a cover that softens the more you carry it.
products.seoTitle: Rowan Field Notebook — pocket dot-grid notebook
products.seoDescription: A pocket-size, lay-flat dot-grid notebook with 120 pages of bleed-resistant cream paper.

products.title: Rowan Everyday Tee
products.description: The one you reach for first. Mid-weight combed cotton with a relaxed, true-to-size fit and a collar that keeps its shape wash after wash. Built to be worn, not saved for later.
products.seoTitle: Rowan Everyday Tee — mid-weight combed cotton
products.seoDescription: A relaxed-fit, mid-weight combed-cotton tee with a collar that holds its shape.

products.title: Rowan Enamel Mug
products.description: A proper camp mug in speckled enamel over steel. Holds twelve ounces, shrugs off drops, and goes from desk to trailhead to campfire without complaint. A little chip only makes it look better.
products.seoTitle: Rowan Enamel Mug — 12oz speckled camp mug
products.seoDescription: A 12oz speckled enamel-over-steel camp mug built for desk, trail, and campfire.

products.title: Rowan Canvas Tote
products.description: Heavy 12oz cotton canvas with real box corners and long shoulder-length handles. Carries a week of groceries or a laptop and lunch, and stands up on its own when you set it down. Machine-washable, gets softer with age.
products.seoTitle: Rowan Canvas Tote — heavy 12oz cotton tote bag
products.seoDescription: A heavy 12oz cotton-canvas tote with box corners and shoulder-length handles.

products.title: Rowan Ripstop Cap
products.description: A lightweight six-panel cap in packable ripstop, with a curved brim you can bend by hand and an adjustable strap that fits nearly everyone. Folds into a pocket and springs back into shape.
products.seoTitle: Rowan Ripstop Cap — packable six-panel cap
products.seoDescription: A lightweight, packable six-panel ripstop cap with a hand-bendable brim and adjustable strap.

products.title: Rowan Insulated Bottle
products.description: Double-walled stainless steel that keeps cold drinks cold for 24 hours and hot ones hot for 12. A soft matte finish that doesn’t sweat, a leak-proof cap, and a slim profile that fits a standard cup holder. Holds 17 oz.
products.seoDescription: A 17oz double-walled stainless bottle: cold for 24h, hot for 12h, leak-proof, matte finish.
